name: NotchNook Pro
tagline: The original notch app for Mac, taken to the next level.
description: NotchNook Pro takes the original notch app for Mac to the next level with 37+ features in the space beneath your camera. Follow Claude Code and Codex sessions, approve commands and respond to requests from the notch. Find what you copied with searchable clipboard history, keep files close with Tray and Pocket, open an integrated terminal, and read scripts with a teleprompter that follows your voice. Music with lyrics, calendar, notes, tasks and timers come together in customizable workspaces. Rearrange widgets with drag and drop and choose the Glass or black appearance. Try Pro free for 48 hours, with no card required. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14.6 or later. US$3/month for up to two Macs; lifetime purchase is also available. Official demo: https://youtu.be/-RqoWJX28Rs
